ops.title: forge-studio: Claude Code OAuth expired — headless `claude -p` cannot run there, so the capt-hook runbook's proof step is blocked on that host
ops.description:
Found 2026-08-30 while running the pre-change baseline of runbook `68af1c77` on both fleet hosts.

`claude -p 'reply with exactly: ok' </dev/null` on `yasyf-forge-studio` (yasyf@100.113.56.52) exits **1** with:

    Failed to authenticate: OAuth session expired and could not be refreshed
    SessionEnd hook ["${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/hook" run SessionEnd] failed: Hook cancelled

Also printed, separately and probably worth fixing at the same time:

    Ignoring 25 permissions.allow entries from .claude/settings.json: this workspace has not been trusted.
    Run Claude Code interactively here once and accept the trust dialog, or set
    projects["/Users/yasyf/Code/daemonkit"].hasTrustDialogAccepted: true in /Users/yasyf/.claude.json

**capt-hook itself is NOT implicated.** The hooks that could fire did fire and dispatch: `capt-hook heartbeats --session <id>` on both attempted sessions returns a populated ledger —

      SessionStart           ×1
      UserPromptSubmit       ×1

`Stop` and `SessionEnd` are absent because the session aborted on auth before reaching them, not because dispatch failed. Everything else on the runbook passes on that host: both agents launchctl status 0, `helper v12.22.3 ok=True`, socket present at `~/.daemonkit/a/com.yasyf.captain-hook.host.v1/daemon.sock`, 141 hooks enumerated, formula 12.22.4 / app 12.22.3 (the decided position, not drift) / uv shim 12.22.4.

**Consequence:** the runbook's steps 7-8 pass condition — a full 4-event lifecycle from a fresh headless session — cannot be reached on forge-studio until someone logs in there. Every verification of that host is currently partial, and a reader who does not know this will read the truncated ledger as a capt-hook failure.

**Fix requires an interactive login on that host**, which no agent can do headlessly.

ops.text: ssh yasyf@100.113.56.52, run `claude` interactively once, complete the OAuth login and accept the trust dialog for ~/Code/daemonkit
`claude -p 'reply with exactly: ok' </dev/null` on forge-studio exits 0 and prints ok
`capt-hook heartbeats --session <that session id>` on forge-studio shows the full SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/Stop/SessionEnd lifecycle, restoring the runbook's pass condition on that host
